projects.name: 50 Years DZ Bank New York
projects.shortDescription: A short film marking 50 years of DZ Bank in New York, told through the people who were there.
projects.description: A milestone worth remembering. To mark 50 years of DZ Bank in New York, we crafted a short film that traces the bank's history in the city — part time capsule, part tribute, told through the people who were there.
projects.seoTitle: 50 Years DZ Bank New York — Image Film by 24stills
projects.seoDescription: An image film marking 50 years of DZ Bank in New York — a time capsule and tribute told through the people who were there. Produced by 24stills.

projects.name: One Night in NYC
projects.shortDescription: A brand documentary for the Carrera Chronograph Seafarer x Hodinkee launch dinner.
projects.description: Hodinkee and TAG Heuer hosted an intimate dinner celebrating the launch of the limited edition Carrera Chronograph Seafarer x Hodinkee and the brand's rich history of 'Decades at Sea.' We supported the evening from concept to delivery — planning the content, filming on-site, and producing assets tailored for release across channels.
projects.seoTitle: One Night in NYC — TAG Heuer x Hodinkee Brand Documentary | 24stills
projects.seoDescription: A brand documentary for TAG Heuer and Hodinkee, filmed at the Carrera Chronograph Seafarer launch dinner in New York. Concept to delivery by 24stills.

projects.name: Leadership Strategies
projects.shortDescription: An event film from Horváth's first leadership event in New York City.
projects.description: Horváth, an international management consultancy, brought their first leadership event to New York City. We captured the energy of the day through conversations with speakers from Hugo Boss, Stanford, and the NBA — letting their words tell the story of what made it worth being there.
projects.seoDescription: An event film for Horváth's first New York leadership event, with speakers from Hugo Boss, Stanford and the NBA. Filmed and edited by 24stills.

projects.name: Undairy the Craving
projects.shortDescription: Video content around a New York City brand experience for Violife.
projects.description: For Violife, 24stills produced video content around a New York City brand experience — following the crew across the city as people had Violife products delivered right to them.
projects.seoTitle: Undairy the Craving — Violife Brand Experience Film | 24stills
projects.seoDescription: Brand experience video content for Violife in New York City, following the crew across the city. Produced by 24stills.

projects.name: DZ Bank: A Summit for 50 Years
projects.shortDescription: An event film from the summit marking DZ Bank's 50th year in New York.
projects.description: A summit to mark half a century of DZ Bank in New York — the conversations, the room, and the people who built the anniversary into something worth filming.
projects.seoTitle: DZ Bank: A Summit for 50 Years — Event Film | 24stills
projects.seoDescription: An event film covering the summit marking 50 years of DZ Bank in New York. Filmed and edited by 24stills.

projects.name: Passion Cycling
projects.shortDescription: A commercial built around the pure feeling of riding.
projects.description: A commercial built around the pure feeling of riding — pace, sweat and asphalt. Shot to move as fast as its subject.
projects.seoDescription: A cycling commercial built around pace, sweat and asphalt — shot to move as fast as its subject. Directed and produced by 24stills.

projects.name: The Handcrafted Art of Signs
projects.shortDescription: A 24stills Original on the Brooklyn sign painter keeping a hand-lettered trade alive.
projects.description: A 24stills Original. In a Brooklyn shop wallpapered with his own work, a sign painter letters by hand — the alphabets pinned to the wall, the brushes, the steady pace of a trade that machines never quite replaced.
projects.seoTitle: The Handcrafted Art of Signs — Van Zee Signs | 24stills
projects.seoDescription: A 24stills Original on Van Zee Signs — a Brooklyn sign painter and the hand-lettered trade he keeps alive.

projects.name: EUROSPINE 2025
projects.shortDescription: An aftermovie from the EUROSPINE 2025 meeting — the halls, the stands, and the people who filled them.
projects.description: EUROSPINE gathered its 2025 meeting under the line “EUROSPINE Empowered”. We covered the days as they ran — the exhibition floor filling up, delegates moving between stands and sessions, and the conversations in between that are the real reason people travel to a congress.
projects.seoDescription: An event aftermovie from the EUROSPINE 2025 meeting — exhibition floor, delegates and the conversations between sessions. Filmed and edited by 24stills.

projects.name: STEP USA
projects.shortDescription: Organizers and participants on what STEP USA gives a company landing in the American market.
projects.description: A programme film for GACC’s STEP USA, built on the people inside it — organizers and participants talking through what the programme actually does — cut against the receptions and sessions where those introductions get made.
projects.seoDescription: A programme film for GACC’s STEP USA, built on interviews with organizers and participants alongside the events where the connections happen. By 24stills.
